ModMetaData.name: Deterrence
ModMetaData.author: Pavel and Codex
ModMetaData.description:
Would you raid a colony whose last attackers are buried outside the walls?
Deterrence reduces the wealth used to size outside threats. Hostile remains, the colony's reputation, and environmental hazards can make a wealthy settlement face smaller raids. Buildings, goods, and trade prices keep their usual value.
Remains count while you keep them, including after burial. Reputation builds from hostile deaths and prisoner treatment. Toxic fallout, hives, and extreme outdoor temperatures build deterrence while they last and leave a fading effect.
Open the shield beside World to inspect each meter or see the colony's history. Tune growth and fading with a live graph, adjust biome and island factors, or give factions different settings. Graves and stockpiles can also sort humanlike corpses by status at death, current faction relations, and individual faction.
Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony. The core mod works without DLC. Existing Antiwealth saves and settings are supported.
